title: VeryOptimizedFabric
description: The goal of this modpack is simple: maximize FPS, reduce lag spikes, and improve overall responsiveness while keeping the game visually clean and mechanically vanilla-friendly.
body:
The goal of this modpack is simple: maximize FPS, reduce lag spikes, and improve overall responsiveness while keeping the game visually clean and mechanically vanilla-friendly. Every included mod has been carefully selected and tested to ensure compatibility and real performance gains.

Unlike heavy modpacks, this one focuses purely on optimization and stability — no unnecessary content, no gameplay overhaul, just raw performance improvements.
